# ESPN Singapore

> > ESPN Singapore provides sports news, live streaming, and WatchESPN activation services for viewers in Singapore and the region.

ESPN Singapore (espn.com.sg) is the regional portal for ESPN's sports content, offering access to live sports streaming through WatchESPN. The platform is operated by ESPN Enterprises, LLC, part of The Walt Disney Company, and provides device activation and streaming setup for sports fans.

## WatchESPN Activation & Setup

- [Activate - WatchESPN](https://www.espn.com.sg/activate): Device activation portal for WatchESPN streaming service
